content: श्रौत {%a.%} (-ती|{%f.%}) [श्रुतौ विहितम् अण्] .²1 Relating to the ear. .²2 Relating to, founded on, or prescribed by, the Veda. .²3 Sacrificial. .²4 Audible, expressed in plain language (as a simile, <ab>opp.</ab> to आर्थ implied). .{@-तम्@} .²1 Any observance prescribed by the Vedas. .²2 Ritual enjoined by the Vedas. .²3 Preservation or maintenance of the sacred fire. .²4 The three sacred fires collectively, ({%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} गार्हपत्य, आहवनीय and दक्षिण).
